name: Splitglass
description:
Live Apple Watch workout data on the G2.

Four screens: run, splits, heart-rate zones, map.

Heart rate, zone, time in zone, distance, pace, energy and elapsed time come from HealthKit, so indoor and outdoor are the same. Zones are the ones set in Health. The map is outdoor only and can follow a GPX route.

Requires the Splitglass iPhone app and an Apple Watch.

Long press: lap, screen, units, plan. Left temple back, right temple forward.
author: Will Grannis

permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Receives live workout readings from the Splitglass iPhone app, either directly on the device or through the splitglass.grannis.xyz relay.

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Draws the breadcrumb map for outdoor workouts and reports how far you are from a loaded route. Never used for indoor workouts, and never sent anywhere.
